effect_description_eng: [When Digivolving] Return 1 red Digimon card with [Avian], [Bird], [Beast], [Animal] or [Sovereign] in any of its traits (other than [Sea Animal]) from your trash to the hand.
inherited_effect_description_eng: [Your Turn] [Once Per Turn] When a card is removed from your opponent's security stack, gain 1 memory.
